# Use Case

`saas/use-case` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

Show how one kind of customer uses the product: eyebrow, heading, text, key points and an image.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `text` | text |  |
| `points` | listItems |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Image on the left.
- **image-right**: Image on the right. Sets `imagePosition: right`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row. | Fine. Stacks on phones through a media query. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/use-case', {
  "eyebrow": "For agencies",
  "heading": "Run every client from one place",
  "text": "Give each client their own workspace and keep billing, approvals and files tidy.",
  "points": [
    "Client-facing approval links",
    "Per-client time and budget tracking",
    "White-label reports"
  ],
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/480x400/png?text=Agency",
    "alt": "A project dashboard showing three client workspaces"
  },
  "cta": {
    "label": "See the agency plan",
    "href": "https://example.com/agencies"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "saas/use-case",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "For agencies",
    "heading": "Run every client from one place",
    "text": "Give each client their own workspace and keep billing, approvals and files tidy.",

      "Client-facing approval links",

    ],

    }
  }
}
```
